segments.text: A "winged one" who is said to be a servant of the gods. Although she is of high status, she is basically a prisoner of those who use her power for their own benefit.
Kanna's lady-in-waiting, who adores her. She's soft-spoken, but also a little unpredictable.
A warrior assigned to guard the shrine where Kanna is kept. He can be a little arrogant, but he's a serious person and is unmatched with the sword.
Sora is a wild crow that Misuzu befriends during the Air arc before meeting Yukito. When Misuzu meets him, he is unable to fly due to him only being a baby.
Sora is the reincarnation of Yukito from the Dream arc. After Misuzu passes away, he leaves the Kamio household on a journey to find her.

A young traveler on a journey to find the meaning in a story his mother left him. A story about a girl who has been all alone in the skies for years. He is able to move puppets without actually touching them, using a magic called "Houjutsu". He lives with Haruko and Misuzu during his stay in their hometown.

After finding out Misuzu is connected to the girl his mother was talking about, he fears that both him and her will perish together, just like in his mother's story. He initially chooses to leave Misuzu behind for her own safety, only to go back on his decision and promise her that he'll always be by her side. He later passes away, reincarnating as Sora during the Air arc.

The second daughter of the Kirishima Clinic, which has served the community for many years. Her parents have passed away, and she now lives with her sister Hijiri, who took over as the clinic's doctor. She's good friends with Potato, a mysterious creature (a dog?) who is always with her.

Kano's older sister, who is the doctor at Kirishima Clinic. She hasn't been working long, but her skills as a doctor are not bad. She is very overprotective of her sister, often going to extremes over how much she cares for her.

A tall, beautiful girl. Her quiet, soft way of doing things at her own pace often gives those around her the impression that she's mysterious and unfathomable. She often spends time with her younger friend, Michiru, at the unmanned station on an abandoned train line.

An energetic young girl always playing at the station together with Minagi, who she loves with all her heart. She accuses Yukito of being a kidnapper when they first meet, and from there they have many battles each time they see each other.

A young girl who attends a school by the sea. She lives together with her mother, Haruko, but takes care of the housheold chores since Haruko is busy with work. She's a bit of an airhead, but is an honest and gentle girl.

Misuzu's mother, who lives a life of indulgence. Her lifestyle doesn't seem to align at all with that of Misuzu, who is still a student, so they rarely spend time with each other. Her greatest joy in life right now is drinking sake.
He is Misuzu's biological father. In Dream, he buys a cake for Misuzu's birthday, but he gives it to Yukito.
A mysterious dog. A pet of Kano.
